never-gonna-give-you-up_youtube_whisper.reason: YouTube file was 213.04 s vs LRCLIB master 214.0 s — wrong master. Whisper word timestamps (±100–200 ms) are also unfit for the 40 ms pass bar.

round2_snap_only.reason: Snapping LRCLIB word priors (±300 ms) left dense-rap residuals ~100–600 ms. Round 3 generates stamps from CTC inside each line window instead of snapping priors.

kendrick_bdkmv_round3_generate.interpretation: Dense rap on a ~30 s preview still fails the 40/100 bar after generate-words. Median improves vs raw LRCLIB but p90 stays ~1.2 s. Production path is full-file companion align, not preview windows.

round3_multi_track_preview.note: Slower tracks can hit ~40 ms median on preview CTC; none clear p90 ≤ 100 ms on these windows.
